title: Unitarizability implies amenability for discrete groups

abstractEnglish: We prove that a discrete group is amenable if and only if every uniformly bounded representation on a complex Hilbert space is similar to a unitary representation. This resolves Dixmier's unitarizability problem affirmatively for discrete groups.
titleEn: Unitarizability implies amenability for discrete groups
titleZh: 离散群的可单位化蕴含顺从性
